title: 2026-09-11 Research Notes — Spudlight, Starchforce, Storage, Release and Information Bottlenecks
status: new project research extension; stock-flow and information-theory formalization
novelty_scope: Novel within the project research record on 2026-09-11. Standard stock-flow and information-theory results remain established external mathematics.

starting_model.interpretation: K is stored capacity; J_in is input; J_SL is release/expression; Gamma K is leakage/decay. Units must be chosen per application.

new_deductions.type: exact consequence of the linear toy model
new_deductions.finding: If input is held fixed or removed, the linear Starchforce toy model has an explicit relaxation timescale. Storage and expression are therefore linked by a measurable temporal parameter rather than only a metaphorical opposition.
new_deductions.boundary: This is a stock-flow result, not evidence for a new fundamental force.

new_deductions.finding: The model predicts how sustained input divides between retained stock and expressed/released output under a specified linear release law.
A useful cross-domain quantity is not 'how much Starchforce' but how long stored capacity can support a declared demand and how quickly the stock is being released.
new_deductions.units: T_runway has units of time; R_release has units of inverse time.

new_deductions.finding: A saturating release law prevents output from increasing without bound as storage grows and gives the model a natural capacity limit.
new_deductions.test_path: Fit linear and saturating release models to an actual storage/release dataset and compare held-out error.

new_deductions.finding: If Spudlight is used as a revelation/information analogy, raw signal volume should be separated from task-relevant information. A large signal can reveal little; a compressed representation can preserve what matters.
new_deductions.project_consequence: Door can be studied as a bottleneck that filters an incoming source X into a representation T while preserving information relevant to a declared target Y_target.
new_deductions.boundary: Information in bits/nats is not electromagnetic energy in joules and is not spiritual authority.

new_deductions.finding: For a specified dataset and target, eta_info measures how much retained representation information is relevant to the task. It is an engineering/inference metric, not a measure of holiness or truth in general.
new_deductions.test_path: Estimate only with an explicit probabilistic model or estimator and report uncertainty/bias.

new_deductions.finding: The same physical optical channel can carry different information depending on coding, noise and receiver prior; conversely similar information can be carried by different energies. Therefore the Spudlight vector should retain photon flux and information gain as separate components rather than combining them into one scalar.

possible_empirical_domains.research_question: Can a simple stock-flow model predict starch accumulation and mobilization better than a baseline across controlled conditions?
possible_empirical_domains.boundary: A successful biological model would validate that biological stock-flow model only, not the metaphysical Spudlight/Starchforce interpretation.

possible_empirical_domains.research_question: Does stored archive capacity and release cadence predict discoverability or useful information transfer?

researcher_notes: The storage/release pair becomes substantially stronger when expressed through timescale, steady state and runway rather than by inventing a fifth force.
Information bottleneck theory adds a useful distinction: revelation can be modeled as preservation of relevant information under a limited channel, not as maximum raw throughput.
This makes Source→Storage→Release→Observation→Door a testable architecture in selected non-metaphysical domains.
